newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat subdued, new crop up on sterling, U.S..
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat subdued, new crop up on sterling, U.S..

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended mixed on Thursday as old crop months fell slightly and new crop rose on an easier sterling and firm U.S. markets, traders said.
New crop positions were supported by continuing weather fears as the sun shone from a clear sky over eastern England.
The small fall in old crop reflected speculative selling ahead of the long holiday weekend, one trader said.
But volume was limited by uncertainty over the foreign exchange market's reaction to the UK general election. "There's an election result tomorrow and sterling could do anything," the trader said.
Just 395 lots changed hands. November was most active with 189 lots, and last traded 1.00 stg higher at 97.50 stg a tonne.
Movement in old crop was much more restricted. There were 122 lots of July done. and it last traded just 0.10 stg lower at 95.90.
In barley only new crop traded, with 23 of a total 33 lots on January, which ended 0.40 stg higher at 95.50.
